article.title: 156个巨噬激活双抗筛出WTa2d1xCD38，IC50低至18.0 pM
article.one_liner: Pagès-Geli等用功能优先的表面组筛选加156个异源scFv-Fc双抗，选出低亲和SIRPα诱饵×CD38分子WTa2d1xCD38；在10条淋巴瘤细胞系上IC50为18.0 pM至3.08 nM，体内可延长生存并与利妥昔单抗联用出现完全治愈。
article.citation: Pagès-Geli C, Ribeiro J, Wienclaw T, Meglan AM, Sloat L, Silva M, 等. High-throughput engineering of bispecific antibodies to enhance macrophage-mediated cytotoxicity of B-cell lymphoma. Nat Commun. 2026 Aug 1;17:8491. doi: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-76180-5
